findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice short questions for Unit 4 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 58 questions numbered 1-58; by section: 4.1 7, 4.2.1 1, 4.2.2 1, 4.2.3 2, 4.2.4 5, 4.3 2, 4.4 2, 4.4.1 3, 4.4.2 2, 4.4.3 5, 4.5 5, 4.6 3, 4.7 5, 4.8 2, 4.8.1 2, 4.8.2 2, 4.8.3 2, 4.9 2, 4.9.1 2, 4.10 3.

Covers sections 4.1-4.10 in book order: definitions, small operations, determinants, properties, adjoint and inverse, row operations, rank, systems and applications, with the portal's own matrices (none from the unit's examples or exercises). Comparison questions are answered as two-column tables. Every answer was recomputed in Python (sympy, check4.py).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
